$comment: What Gofer knows about each Cerebras model, because Cerebras will not say. `GET https://api.cerebras.ai/v1/models` answers `{id, object, created, owned_by}` and nothing else — no context window, no output ceiling, no tool support, no reasoning. Every other driver reads those facts off a catalogue; this one has none to read, so the facts are measured by hand and shipped here. `scripts/generate-command-surface.mjs` emits `CEREBRAS_MODELS` in `src-tauri/src/settings.rs` from this file, which is what `cerebras_model_options` intersects the live id list against.
$hiddenComment: A model this file does not name is not offered. The live endpoint is the authority on which models a key can reach, and this file is the authority on what they can do — so a model Cerebras adds later is invisible until it is measured and added here. Offering it on guessed numbers would be a picker entry whose every request fails on a ceiling nobody checked.
$noteComment: `note` is the measurement that produced the row and becomes the Rust doc comment. It is prose, so it is written here and never derived.

models.name: GPT OSS 120B
models.note: Measured on 2026-08-27. The window is the number the endpoint names itself: a 300,000-token prompt answers HTTP 400 `context_length_exceeded`, "Current length is 300068 while limit is 131000". Not 131,072 — the two models on this endpoint do not share a window. Output has no ceiling of its own and shares that window, so `maxTokens` repeats it and `ceiling_within` cuts it down. `image_url` answers 400 "Content type 'image_url' is not supported by selected model", so text only. Reasoning is mandatory: the API validator accepts `reasoning_effort: "none"` and the chat template then refuses it with "Unsupported reasoning effort: none. Supported values are 'low', 'medium', and 'high'." So this model has no word for stopping and carries no `offEffort`.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B IT
models.note: Measured on 2026-08-27. The window is the endpoint's own number, "limit is 131072", and output shares it. `image_url` is accepted, so text and image. `reasoning_effort: "none"` is accepted by both the validator and the template, and the reply comes back with no `reasoning` field at all — so unlike its neighbour this model has a real word for stopping, and `off` sends it rather than sending nothing.
